verdict.rationale: The pack documents OpenAI API compatibility through a base URL, key and model swap, and it documents tool calling. Both are general building blocks, not first-party integration guides for coding agents or agent frameworks. No Cerebras doc page in the pack covers a specific coding agent or framework; one community comment mentions 'official support' for Cursor but cites no first-party guide.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the provider into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, first-party integration guides
